title: Swabs versus native specimens in severe head and neck infections: a prospective pilot study and suggestions for clinical management
summary: Head and neck infections, especially dental infections, can cause serious problems if not treated correctly. Tissue samples from the body are rarely used to identify germs, and swabs are more commonly used, but they are less reliable, especially in infections with many different germs. This study looks at the benefits of using tissue samples instead of swabs for treating severe head and neck infections.

interventions.name:
